value.localization_note: Odd bulk masses may exponentially suppress f_i(L), but a finite nonzero boundary value still gives a nonzero mass.
value.qualification: This proves the zero-mode overlap matrix, not the regulated determinant of the complete boundary-condition-shifted KK tower.
value.why_local: All four H chirals are even and have nonzero boundary values at y=L; Theta and the full Spin(10) bilinears are co-located there.

exact_results.statement: No nonzero-orientation PS-U1F invariant occurs through degree 19; explicit degree-20 invariants exist with orientation +/-12
Equal-level family-universal discrete-R universality forces both degree-20 oriented invariants to have W charge two

assumptions: The three Q families have one charge q and the three Qc families one charge qc. A generic 3x3 Q_i H Qc_j matrix enforces this family universality.
Q H Qc, ThetaPlus A16 Bbar16, and ThetaMinus C16 Dbar16 are allowed W terms.
r(ThetaPlus)=t and r(ThetaMinus)=-t; no value of r(H)=h is assumed.
The three PS factors have equal level and one universal GS residue, so A4=A2L=A2R mod eta.
Any 126/bar126 or other complete-Spin10 threshold contributes the same common shift C to all three mixed rows.
value.conclusion: No Z_N^R satisfying these equal-level universal mixed-anomaly conditions can forbid both first oriented degree-20 local invariants.
deduction: Adding the two differences gives 12-4h=0 mod 2eta.
Substitution gives 12q+6-4t=0 mod 2eta and therefore mod N.
The conjugate equation is 12qc+6+4t=0 mod N.
